units.source_text: 这种时候，他总是茫然地望着房间的窗口。

en.t: At times like this, he would always stare blankly at the window of the room.

units.source_text: 黑松的嫩芽像支铅笔，罗汉松的嫩芽像蜻蜓的翅膀在飞翔。

en.t: The young shoots of the black pines looked like pencils, and the young shoots of the yew plum pines looked like dragonfly wings in flight.
